epigraph.english: Nothing is built on stone; all is built on sand, but we must build as if the sand were stone. --Jorge Luis Borges
epigraph.chinese: 没有什么建在磐石上，一切都建在沙上；但我们必须把沙当作磐石来建造。
epigraph.author: 豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯

proseCodeBlocks.text: *With a sufficient number of users of an API, it does not matter what you promise in the contract: all observable behaviors of your system will be depended on by somebody.*
proseCodeBlocks.reason: The original book presents this as a quotation, not executable code.

proseCodeBlocks.text: *只要 API 的用户足够多，不论你在契约中作了什么承诺，系统的每一种可观察行为都会被某些用户依赖。*
proseCodeBlocks.reason: Chinese counterpart of Hyrum's Law; indentation incorrectly produced a code block.

translatorNotes.text:
[一条微博引发的思考——再谈“Software Stack”之“软件栈”译法！](https://www.ituring.com.cn/article/1144)
软件栈（Software Stack），是指为了实现某种完整功能解决方案（例如某款产品或服务）所需的一套软件子系统或组件。
translatorNotes.title: 译者补充：软件栈（非原书内容）

它在概念上类似于熵：讨论长期变更和维护时必须考虑海勒姆定律，就像讨论效率或热力学时必须考虑熵一样。
也会破坏某些使用方式。
哈希洪水攻击使人们更有理由采用非确定性的哈希遍历顺序。
